title: Time Range Picker
api:
interface TimeRangePickerProps {
  value?: TimeRangeValue
  defaultValue?: TimeRangeValue
  onValueChange?: (value: TimeRangeValue) => void
  label?: string
  startLabel?: string
  endLabel?: string
  /** A name produces `${name}.start` and `${name}.end` native form entries. */
  name?: string
  startName?: string
  endName?: string
  form?: string
  required?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  loading?: boolean
  readOnly?: boolean
  min?: string
  max?: string
  step?: number
  allowOvernight?: boolean
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  clearable?: boolean
  error?: string
  className?: string
  id?: string
  'aria-label'?: string
  'aria-labelledby'?: string
  'aria-describedby'?: string
  'aria-invalid'?: AriaAttributes['aria-invalid']
}

export type { TimeRangeValue } from './time-utils'

function TimeRangePicker({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onValueChange,
  label,
  startLabel: startLabelProp,
  endLabel: endLabelProp,
  name,
  startName,
  endName,
  form,
  required,
  disabled,
  loading = false,
  readOnly,
  min,
  max,
  step = 1,
  allowOvernight = false,
  size = 'md',
  clearable = true,
  error,
  className,
  id,
  'aria-label': ariaLabel,
  'aria-labelledby': labelledBy,
  'aria-describedby': describedBy,
  'aria-invalid': invalid,
}: TimeRangePickerProps);

props.name: name
props.description: A name produces `${name}.start` and `${name}.end` native form entries.

notes: TimeRangeValue is {start: string|null, end: string|null}. name submits two form fields.
allowOvernight defaults to false. Opt in for ranges crossing midnight; application logic owns date/timezone interpretation.
